links.comparator_used: General-purpose base models (Mistral-7B instruct, Llama2-7B), fine-tuned and evaluated under identical settings
links.outcome: ICD-10-CM coding F-score after fine-tuning (internal test set)
links.effect: Full-code F: BioMistral 0.780 vs Mistral-instruct 0.760; MedLlama2 0.774 vs Llama2 0.749. Top-50 F: BioMistral 0.906 vs Mistral-instruct 0.877; MedLlama2 0.880 vs Llama2 0.868. The advantage persisted on the KMUH RCT dataset (BioMistral 0.754 vs Mistral 0.736 full-code F). No significance testing was reported for the comparisons.
links.quote: BioMistral achieved the highest downstream performance (F 1 -score = 0.78; win rate = 69.2%), followed by MedLlama2 and Mistral.

links.comparator_used: BioMistral trained on the full, non-deduplicated dataset (DischgDiag only)
links.outcome: Coding precision, recall and F-score, and training time
links.effect: Deduplicated model outperformed the baseline on precision, recall and F1 and cut training time by 10.2%. Full-code F rose from 0.780 to 0.786 on the internal test set, from 0.754 to 0.764 on the KMUH RCT data, and from 0.620 to 0.626 on TMMH.
links.quote: As shown in Fig. 5 , the deduplicated model consistently outperformed the baseline across precision, recall, and F 1 -scores, and reduced total training time by 10.2%.

links.comparator_used: Manual coding by certified coding specialists without AI assistance (control workflow in a randomized weekly rotation)
links.outcome: Coding time per discharge summary (RQ1) and coder satisfaction
links.effect: Across 10,688 coded summaries, all three AI-assisted workflows (HAN, PubMedGPT-2, BioMistral) were faster than manual coding (Games-Howell, all p < 0.001). PubMedGPT-2 gave the largest time reduction, followed by BioMistral and HAN. The text gives no mean times in seconds. Workflow uptake rose from 37.26% to 90.59%.
links.tradeoff: Satisfaction varied by model and coder background: HAN users were less likely to give positive or neutral ratings, and coders with <10 years of experience and Gen Y were the least satisfied. One late-career coder withdrew because they would not adopt the AI interface. Weekly rotation may be confounded by time, and the rotation was truncated by an ICD-10-CM version transition. Accuracy was not directly compared in the trial.
links.quote: All three AI-assisted workflows yielded faster completion times than manual coding (Games-Howell, all p < 0.001).

design_hint: human-in-the-loop AI-assisted coding with coder review
